# D & D Fence (full)

D & D Fence is a fence contractor serving Ennis and Waxahachie, TX, building and repairing privacy, cedar, chain link and wrought iron fences within about 25 miles of both towns.

## Business Information
- Owner: Austin Dunnahue
- Phone: (469) 321-7783
- Email: dunnahuea@gmail.com
- Address: Service-area business with no public street address. Serves Ennis, TX and Waxahachie, TX (Ellis County).
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 7 AM to 6 PM. Closed Saturday and Sunday.
- Service Area: Ennis, TX; Waxahachie, TX; and properties within about 25 miles of both
- Years in business: 6
- Google Business Profile: https://share.google/YeJ2GN1LFZbrmb75W

## Services
- Privacy Fence: privacy fence installation for residential backyards and property lines
- Cedar Fence: cedar wood fence installation for privacy, backyard and decorative fencing
- Chain Link: chain link fencing for yards, perimeters and security fencing
- Wrought Iron: wrought iron fencing for decorative, security and pool fence applications
- Fence Repair: repair of existing fences and gates
- Fence Installation: new fence and gate installation for residential and farm properties

## Full About
D & D Fence is a fence contractor owned by Austin Dunnahue. It has built and repaired fences around Ennis and Waxahachie in Ellis County, Texas for 6 years. The work runs from a backyard privacy run to new fence and gate installation on residential and farm properties, plus repair of fences and gates that are already standing.

### How an estimate runs
An estimate starts at the property. The fence line is walked and measured, the ground, the gate locations and any old fence are noted, and the quote comes back in writing. Before any digging, the property line is confirmed from the owner's plat or survey and the city and HOA rules for the address are checked.

### Ground conditions
Ennis and Waxahachie sit on Blackland Prairie clay, which swells after heavy rain and shrinks and cracks in a dry summer. That movement works fence posts out of line, so D & D Fence treats a leaning section as a post problem first and a board problem second.

### Service area
D & D Fence covers Ennis and Waxahachie, which are about 15 miles apart on US 287, and the area within about 25 miles of both. The Ennis page covers Blackland Prairie ground, acreage fencing and who to call at the City. The Waxahachie page covers the City of Waxahachie's published residential fence permit checklist. Properties outside that area: call (469) 321-7783 and describe the job.

### Contact
Phone (469) 321-7783, Monday to Friday 7 AM to 6 PM. Email dunnahuea@gmail.com. The estimate form at https://d-d-fence.pageone.cloud/contact/ accepts requests at any hour and is answered during business hours.

## About
